risks: Actor+permission-only grants can authorize the wrong resource/workspace; Entity.permissions is a capability catalog and must never become an ACL.

Status adapters mark native writes live without authenticated resource authority; identity disconnect's granted=true concerns connection deletion, not permission.revoke. Reusing it would manufacture authorization/evidence.

IdentityStore and OrgsStoreFile are established local metadata/membership stores, not shared grants or authenticated principals. Adding a second grant/entity store there would violate one-authority cutover.

Published WP-03 transaction/outbox requirements rely on primitives generalized later in WP-04, and revoke fence is fully closed later in WP-51. Treat these as separate foundation/capability gates, not silently cyclic new DAG edges or permission to weaken DoD.

An epoch update without fencing in-flight responses/subscriptions allows post-revoke plaintext/event delivery. A partitioned sync consumer needs bounded lease fail-closed semantics before an applied revoke claim.

Eventual search/cache purge alone leaks titles/snippets/totals; current ACL must guard every target projection before serialization, including mentions/notifications/agent context and stale cursor queries.

Cached plaintext cannot be made unread retroactively. Requirements address future service reads/delivery and fresh rendered/context exposure; persistent derived artifacts need provenance controls, not a false un-read guarantee.

Channels/mail inheritance, public-link expiry, editor share powers and guest mapping are not encoded by current OrgRole/WorkspaceRole; identity contracts must make them explicit without changing existing organization semantics.

Exact renderer, preview/search, agent/MCP, HTTP composition and notification consumer source symbols are outside this assigned inspection scope. The report requests their root-owner mapping and common policy attachment rather than inventing inspected evidence.

No tests/builds/UI/network operations were run. All behavioral verification entries are future required scenarios, never results; featureComplete is false and every applicable DoD remains missing/not verified.

Live root-owned integration may change inspected files or create currently absent directories after hashing. Revalidate whole-file digests and line/symbol references at the accepted implementation revision; supplied input HEAD is not asserted to be the current working tree's exact source state.
